The increase in Operating Expenses raises a minor concern that needs monitoring.  The cost of goods sold increased but not proportionally to revenue.

The company demonstrates substantial growth in assets and revenue. Therefore, the sentiment is slightly positive but warrants close monitoring of cost management and the accuracy of the net income number.
